summary: 冈本多绪获THR Trailblazer · 滨口《突然》
detail: 日本演员冈本多绪（Tao Okamoto）于东京American Film Night（THR Japan × MPA）2026-10-27/28获The Hollywood Reporter Trailblazer Award，表彰其国际突破。她因滨口龙介《突然 / All of a Sudden》获曹纳最佳女演员（与维吉妮·埃菲拉并列）。活动于东京American Club举行，首相高市早苗致贺词。THR 2026-10-28。
summaryEn: Tao Okamoto Wins THR Trailblazer Award; Hamaguchi's All of a Sudden
detailEn: Japanese actress Tao Okamoto received The Hollywood Reporter Trailblazer Award at American Film Night (THR Japan × MPA) in Tokyo on 2026-10-27/28, honoring her international breakthrough. She won Best Actress at Cannes (tied with Virginie Efira) for Ryusuke Hamaguchi's All of a Sudden. The event was held at the American Club in Tokyo, with a congratulatory message from Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi. THR, 2026-10-28.

summary: 金马63评审团 · 张艾嘉任主席
detail: 第63届金马奖执委会10月28日公布决选评审团15人，张艾嘉（Sylvia Chang）时隔15年再任主席。成员包括朱淑仪、张吉安、黄文英等。典礼11月22日台北流行音乐中心。官方 / UDN / TVBS 2026-10-28。
summaryEn: 63rd Golden Horse Awards Jury · Sylvia Chang as Chair
detailEn: On October 28, the 63rd Golden Horse Awards executive committee announced its 15-member final jury, with Sylvia Chang serving as chair again after 15 years. Members include Chu Shu-yi, Chong Keat-aun, and Huang Wen-ying. The ceremony takes place November 22 at the Taipei Music Center. Official / UDN / TVBS 2026-10-28.

summary: 哥谷36提名 · 滨口《突然》等目录片领跑
detail: 第36届哥谷奖10月27日公布提名：滨口龙介《突然 / All of a Sudden》获最佳国际片、最佳导演等4项提名；迈克·利《温柔的关怀》4项；安德烈·萨金塞夫《米诺陶》国际片与导演；李沧东《可能的爱情》国际片、原著剧本与全度妍主演；詹姆斯·格雷《纸老虎》最佳故事片；马丁·麦克多纳《野马九号》原著剧本与约翰·马尔科维奇主演；帕维乌·帕夫利科夫斯基《祖国》国际片；《纳扎》纪录片。颁奖典礼11月30日纽约Cipriani。官方 / Variety / Screen Daily 2026-10-27。
summaryEn: 36th Golden Horse nominations · Hamaguchi's All of a Sudden leads among catalog titles
detailEn: Nominations for the 36th Golden Horse Awards were announced October 27: Ryusuke Hamaguchi's All of a Sudden earned 4 nods including Best International Film and Best Director; Mike Leigh's A Gentle Care took 4; Andrey Zvyagintsev's Minotaur landed International Film and Director; Lee Chang-dong's Possible Love got International Film, Original Screenplay, and a Best Actress nod for Jeon Do-yeon; James Gray's Paper Tiger for Best Feature; Martin McDonagh's Wild Horse Nine for Original Screenplay and a Best Actor nod for John Malkovich; Paweł Pawlikowski's Motherland for International Film; and Naza for Documentary. The awards ceremony is November 30 at Cipriani in New York. Official / Variety / Screen Daily 2026-10-27.

summary: 东京39开幕 · Gala 峡湾/野马九号
detail: 第39届东京国际电影节今日（2026-10-26）在日比谷开幕，开幕片为濑々敬久《SUKIYAKI 上向走》，中心片《哥斯拉-0.0》，闭幕《科罗尼》。Gala 单元含基里斯蒂安·蒙吉金棕榈《峡湾 / Fjord》与马丁·麦克多纳《野马九号 / Wild Horse Nine》（已早前定档，本次为实际开幕）。主竞赛15部仍无目录内作者片。Variety / Screen / THR / 官方 2026-10-26。
summaryEn: 39th Tokyo opens · Gala slate includes Fjord and Wild Horse Nine
detailEn: The 39th Tokyo International Film Festival opened today (2026-10-26) in Hibiya, with the opening film SUKIYAKI Agatteke by Zeze Takahisa, the centerpiece Godzilla-0.0, and the closing film Coroni. The Gala section includes Cristian Mungiu's Palme d'Or winner Fjord and Martin McDonagh's Wild Horse Nine (previously announced; this is the actual opening). The 15-title main competition still features no auteur titles from the catalog. Variety / Screen / THR / Official 2026-10-26.

summary: critic 86% · 格雷《纸老虎》
detail: 詹姆斯·格雷《纸老虎 / Paper Tiger》Tomatometer 86%（80条影评，均分约7.0/10），Metacritic 79。更纳主竞赛后样本扩大达 Certified Fresh；Neon 11/13 美限映、11/20 全国。Rotten Tomatoes 官宣 / Wikipedia 汇总 10/23。
summaryEn: Critics 86% · Gray's Paper Tiger
detailEn: James Gray's Paper Tiger holds an 86% Tomatometer (80 reviews, average around 7.0/10) and a Metacritic score of 79. After its Cannes competition premiere the larger sample earned it Certified Fresh status; Neon opens it in limited US release 11/13 and nationwide 11/20. Rotten Tomatoes official / Wikipedia roundup 10/23.

summary: 韩国影评人协会最佳影片 · 李沧东《可能的爱情》
detail: 第46届韩国电影评论家协会奖（Youngpyeong Awards）10月19–20日公布：李沧东《可能的爱情 / Possible Love》获最佳影片，全度妍获最佳女主角。纳宏镇《希望 / Hope》获最佳导演、赵寅成最佳男主角与最佳摄影。颁奖典礼定于11月4日在首尔KOFA电影资料馆举行。Yonhap / Asian Movie Pulse 2026-10-20。
summaryEn: Korean Film Critics Association Best Picture · Lee Chang-dong's Possible Love
detailEn: The 46th Korean Film Critics Association Awards (Youngpyeong Awards) were announced on October 19–20: Lee Chang-dong's Possible Love won Best Picture and Jeon Do-yeon won Best Actress. Na Hong-jin's Hope won Best Director, with Zo In-sung taking Best Actor and Best Cinematography. The awards ceremony is set for November 4 at the KOFA Film Archive in Seoul. Yonhap / Asian Movie Pulse 2026-10-20.

summary: 芝加哥62金雨果 · 格里策巴赫《梦想的冒险》
detail: 第62届芝加哥国际电影节10月23日公布竞赛奖项：瓦莱斯卡·格里策巴赫《梦想的冒险 / The Dreamed Adventure》获 Gold Hugo 最佳影片；滨口龙介与莱娅·勒迪姆纳《突然 / All of a Sudden》获 Silver Hugo 最佳编剧；是枝裕和《蓦然回首 / Look Back》摄影上野千草获最佳摄影。评委包括约翰·C·赖利、伊尔迪科·埃涅迪等。Cinema/Chicago / Wikipedia 2026-10-23。
summaryEn: Chicago 62nd Gold Hugo · Grisebach's The Dreamed Adventure
detailEn: The 62nd Chicago International Film Festival announced its competition awards on October 23: Valeska Grisebach's The Dreamed Adventure won the Gold Hugo for Best Picture; Ryusuke Hamaguchi and Léa Ledimna's All of a Sudden won the Silver Hugo for Best Screenplay; Chigusa Ueno won Best Cinematography for Hirokazu Kore-eda's Look Back. The jury included John C. Reilly and Ildikó Enyedi, among others. Cinema/Chicago / Wikipedia 2026-10-23.

summary: critic 100% · 利《温柔的关怀》
detail: 迈克·利《温柔的关怀 / Tender Loving Care》Tomatometer 100%（约41–45条影评，均分约8.5/10），Metacritic 85（13评）。圣塞74金贝壳、最佳编剧与凯特·奥弗林最佳主演后样本扩大仍完美 Fresh；美 Bleecker Street 12/4 有限，英 StudioCanal 2027-02-12。Wikipedia / RT / Metacritic 汇总 10/23。
summaryEn: Critics 100% · Leigh's Tender Loving Care
detailEn: Mike Leigh's Tender Loving Care holds a 100% Tomatometer (about 41–45 reviews, average score around 8.5/10) and a Metacritic score of 85 (13 reviews). After winning the Golden Shell, Best Screenplay and Best Leading Performance for Kate O'Flynn at San Sebastián 74, the film remains perfectly Fresh as its sample has grown; Bleecker Street opens it in limited release in the US on 12/4, and StudioCanal in the UK on 2027-02-12. Wikipedia / RT / Metacritic roundup 10/23.

summary: 美加英爱日院线上映 · 李沧东《可能的爱情》
detail: 李沧东《可能的爱情 / Possible Love》今日（2026-10-23）在美国、加拿大、英国、爱尔兰与日本有限院线上映（澳大利亚已于 10/22 上映）；韩国院线为 9/23。影片威尼斯评审团大奖、韩国第99届奥斯卡国际片候选；Netflix 全球流媒体定档 11/6。Variety / Netflix Tudum / 各地院线排片。
summaryEn: US, Canada, UK, Ireland and Japan theatrical release · Lee Chang-dong's Possible Love
detailEn: Lee Chang-dong's Possible Love opens in limited theatrical release today (2026-10-23) in the US, Canada, the UK, Ireland and Japan (Australia opened on 10/22); its Korean theatrical release was 9/23. The film won the Venice Grand Jury Prize and is South Korea's submission for the 99th Academy Awards International Feature category; its global Netflix streaming date is set for 11/6. Variety / Netflix Tudum / local theatrical listings.

summary: 韩国院线上映 · 洪常秀《无处安放双眼》
detail: 洪常秀第35部长片《无处安放双眼 / Nowhere to Lay My Eyes》（눈 둘 데가 없네）今日（2026-10-21）在韩国院线上映；金敏喜主演，崔明吉、权海骐、申锡昊、朴美昭出演，片长约72分钟。影片洛卡诺主竞赛获最佳导演、金敏喜最佳表演与普世评审团奖，并入选纽约电影节主单元与釜山 Icons。KMDb / Cine21 / Jeonwonsa 档期；Cine21 开画日已录得上座。
summaryEn: Korean theatrical release · Hong Sang-soo's Nowhere to Lay My Eyes
detailEn: Hong Sang-soo's 35th feature Nowhere to Lay My Eyes (눈 둘 데가 없네) opens in Korean theaters today (2026-10-21); starring Kim Min-hee, with Choi Myung-gil, Kwon Hae-hyo, Shin Seok-ho and Park Mi-so, running about 72 minutes. The film won Best Director, Best Performance for Kim Min-hee and the Universal Jury Prize in Locarno's main competition, and was selected for the New York Film Festival main slate and Busan Icons. Scheduling per KMDb / Cine21 / Jeonwonsa; Cine21 has already recorded admissions on opening day.

summary: 北美院线定档 · 是枝《蓦然回首》12/30 有限映
detail: GKids 10/20 官宣是枝裕和《蓦然回首 / Look Back》北美档期：12/30 精选影院有限上映，2027-01-15 全国扩映。影片威尼斯主竞赛世界首映，改编藤本树漫画；日本 9/11 上映，韩国 10/8。The Wrap / Anime News Network / GKids 2026-10-20。
summaryEn: North American theatrical date set · Kore-eda's Look Back limited release 12/30
detailEn: GKids announced on 10/20 the North American release dates for Hirokazu Kore-eda's Look Back: a limited release in select theaters on 12/30, expanding nationwide on 2027-01-15. The film had its world premiere in Venice's main competition and adapts Tatsuki Fujimoto's manga; it opened in Japan on 9/11 and in Korea on 10/8. The Wrap / Anime News Network / GKids 2026-10-20.

summary: BFI伦敦70最佳影片 · 洛兹尼察《帝国》
detail: 谢尔盖·洛兹尼察档案纪录片《帝国 / Imperium》获第70届 BFI 伦敦电影节 Official Competition 最佳影片（10/18 闭幕颁奖）。影片借意大利摄影师1970年代初苏联素材重访帝国社会文化景观，威尼斯 Open 单元首映。同期 Sutherland 奖给泰国《九座通往天堂的庙》（Sompot Chidgasornpongse），Grierson 纪录片奖给《水泥之地》（Asmahan Bkerat）。BFI / Variety / Screen 2026-10-18。
summaryEn: BFI London 70 Best Film · Loznitsa's Imperium
detailEn: Sergei Loznitsa's archival documentary Imperium won Best Film in the Official Competition of the 70th BFI London Film Festival (awarded at the closing ceremony on 10/18). Drawing on Soviet footage shot by an Italian photographer in the early 1970s, the film revisits the social and cultural landscape of the empire; it premiered in Venice's Open section. The Sutherland Award went to Thailand's Nine Temples to Heaven (Sompot Chidgasornpongse), and the Grierson Award for documentary to Land of Cement (Asmahan Bkerat). BFI / Variety / Screen 2026-10-18.

summary: critic 98% · 萨金塞夫《米诺陶》
detail: 安德烈·萨金塞夫《米诺陶 / Minotaur》Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer 约 98%（47 条影评，均分约 8.6/10）。更纳评审团大奖作品；法国 10/14 院线上映。报道日期约 2026-10。
summaryEn: critics 98% · Serebrennikov's Minotaur
detailEn: Andrey Serebrennikov's Minotaur holds a Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer of about 98% (47 reviews, average score about 8.6/10). It won the Grand Prix in Cannes and opens in French theaters on 10/14. Reported around 2026-10.

summary: 法国院线上映 · 萨金塞夫《米诺陶》
detail: 安德烈·萨金塞夫更纳评审团大奖《米诺陶 / Minotaur》今日（10/14）由 Les Films du Losange 在法国院线上映。影片以《不忠的女人》为灵感，讲述当代迷宫中的权力、背叛与生存；Cannes 2026 获 Grand Prix。RT 约 98%（47 条影评）。
summaryEn: French theatrical release · Serebrennikov's Minotaur
detailEn: Andrey Zvyagintsev's Grand Prix-winning Minotaur opens in French theaters today (10/14) via Les Films du Losange. Inspired by The Unfaithful Wife, the film explores power, betrayal and survival in a contemporary labyrinth; it won the Grand Prix at Cannes 2026. RT score around 98% (47 reviews).

summary: 家用版上线日官宣 · 诺兰《奥德赛》11/17 数字与4K
detail: 环球家庭娱乐 10/13 公布诺兰《奥德赛》家用版内容：11/17 同步上线 PVOD 数字购租（Apple TV / Prime Video / Fandango at Home / YouTube）及 4K UHD、蓝光、DVD，附约90分钟幕后特辑与 IMAX 独家序幕（档期8月已公布）。全球票房约17.8亿美元。Forbes 2026-10-13。
summaryEn: Home release date announced: Nolan's The Odyssey arrives on digital and 4K on 11/17
detailEn: Universal Home Entertainment announced on 10/13 the home release details for Nolan's The Odyssey: PVOD digital purchase and rental (Apple TV / Prime Video / Fandango at Home / YouTube) plus 4K UHD, Blu-ray and DVD all launch on 11/17, with roughly 90 minutes of behind-the-scenes extras and an IMAX-exclusive prologue (the date was announced back in August). Global box office is about $1.78 billion. Forbes, 2026-10-13.

summary: critic 87% · 阿尔莫多瓦尔《苦涩圣诞》
detail: 《苦涩圣诞 / Bitter Christmas（Amarga Navidad）》Tomatometer 约 87%（69 条影评，均分约 7.4/10；RT 影片页现 70 条且已出共识），Metacritic 69（23 评，未过 80）。佩德罗·阿尔莫多瓦尔执导，更纳主竞赛国际首映后影评累积跨过 80%；美索尼 11/13 有限。Wikipedia / RT 名录汇总 10/4。
summaryEn: Critics 87% · Almodóvar's Bitter Christmas
detailEn: Bitter Christmas (Amarga Navidad) holds a Tomatometer of about 87% (69 reviews, average around 7.4/10; the RT film page currently shows 70 reviews and a consensus has been posted), and a Metacritic score of 69 (23 reviews, below 80). Directed by Pedro Almodóvar, the film crossed 80% as reviews accumulated following its international premiere in Cannes competition; Sony opens it in limited release on 11/13 in the US. Compiled from Wikipedia / RT listings, 10/4.

summary: critic 100% · 亚伯拉罕/绍尔《纳扎》美限映
detail: 《纳扎 / NAZA》Tomatometer 100%（23 条影评，均分约 9.1/10），Metacritic 94（15 评）。威尼斯评审团特别奖、圣塞74欧洲片观众奖后，美 9/30 起 IFC Center 有限上映，10/9 扩至洛杉矶等地；英 10/15 Dogwoof。Wikipedia / RT / Metacritic / Guardian 汇总 9/30。
summaryEn: Critics 100% · Abraham/Sauer's NAZA opens in limited US release
detailEn: NAZA holds a Tomatometer of 100% (23 reviews, average around 9.1/10) and a Metacritic score of 94 (15 reviews). After winning the Special Jury Prize at Venice and the Audience Award for a European film at San Sebastián 74, it opened in limited release at IFC Center in the US on 9/30 and expands to Los Angeles and other cities on 10/9; Dogwoof releases it in the UK on 10/15. Compiled from Wikipedia / RT / Metacritic / Guardian, 9/30.

summary: critic 93% · 蒙吉《峡湾》金棕榈后
detail: 《峡湾 / Fjord》Tomatometer 约 93%（72 条影评，均分约 7.9/10），Metacritic 81（22 评）。克里斯蒂安·蒙吉执导，塞巴斯蒂安·斯坦与蕾娜特·赖因斯夫主演；扎纳金棕榈、FIPRESCI 与评委会外多项后样本扩大仍 Certified Fresh。罗马尼亚第99届奥斯卡国际片候选；Neon 10/9 北美院线，NYFF64 Spotlight。Wikipedia / RT / Metacritic 汇总 9/30。
summaryEn: Critics 93% · Mungiu's Fjord after the Palme d'Or
detailEn: Fjord: Tomatometer around 93% (72 reviews, average score about 7.9/10), Metacritic 81 (22 reviews). Directed by Cristian Mungiu, starring Sebastian Stan and Renate Reinsve; after its Cannes Palme d'Or, FIPRESCI and Jury Prize wins, it remains Certified Fresh as the sample widened beyond those awards. Romania's submission for the 99th Academy Awards International Feature; Neon opens it in North American theaters 10/9, NYFF64 Spotlight. Wikipedia / RT / Metacritic roundup 9/30.

summary: critic 96% · 滨口《突然》NYFF后
detail: 《突然 / All of a Sudden》（法 Soudain）Tomatometer 约 96%（47 条影评，均分约 8.5/10），Metacritic 87（15 评）。滨口龙介法语首作，更纳主竞赛维吉妮·埃菲拉与冈本多绪并列最佳女演员；NYFF64 主单元、芝加哥62国际竞赛。Neon 11/25 北美院线。Wikipedia / RT / Metacritic 汇总 9/30。
summaryEn: critic 96% · Hamaguchi's All of a Sudden after NYFF
detailEn: All of a Sudden (French title Soudain): Tomatometer around 96% (47 reviews, average score about 8.5/10), Metacritic 87 (15 reviews). Ryusuke Hamaguchi's first French-language feature; at Cannes in Competition, Virginie Efira and Tao Okamoto shared Best Actress; NYFF64 Main Slate, Chicago 62nd International Competition. Neon opens it in North American theaters 11/25. Wikipedia / RT / Metacritic roundup 9/30.

summaryEn: critic 94% · McDonagh's Wild Horse Nine after Venice

Wikipedia / RT summary 9/28–29.
